<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php';
global $wpdb;

// Asegura que el formulario de CF7 tenga ID 5 (el que usa contacto.php)
$form = get_posts(['post_type' => 'wpcf7_contact_form', 'numberposts' => 1, 'post_status' => 'any']);
if ($form && (int) $form[0]->ID !== 5) {
  $old = (int) $form[0]->ID;
  $wpdb->delete($wpdb->posts, ['ID' => 5]);
  $wpdb->update($wpdb->posts, ['ID' => 5], ['ID' => $old]);
  $wpdb->update($wpdb->postmeta, ['post_id' => 5], ['post_id' => $old]);
  clean_post_cache($old);
}

// Contenido de ejemplo
$theme = get_stylesheet_directory();
$imgs = ['banner_nosotros.jpg', 'banner_cotizador.jpg', 'banner_contacto.jpg', '../slider-principal/banner-promocion-desktop.jpg'];
$deco = wp_insert_term('Decoración', 'category', ['slug' => 'decoracion']);
$estilo = wp_insert_term('Estilo', 'category', ['slug' => 'estilo']);
$posts = [
  ['Cómo elegir el cuadro ideal para tu living', $deco['term_id'], 0],
  ['Láminas y prints: ideas para una pared vacía', $deco['term_id'], 1],
  ['Marcos: madera, negro o blanco', $estilo['term_id'], 2],
  ['Combina colores sin miedo en tu hogar', $estilo['term_id'], 3],
];
foreach ($posts as [$title, $cat, $i]) {
  $id = wp_insert_post([
    'post_title' => $title, 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_category' => [$cat],
    'post_content' => 'Contenido de ejemplo de la demo del tema DaleColor.',
  ]);
  $src = $theme . '/assets/imagenes/banners/' . $imgs[$i];
  $tmp = wp_tempnam($src);
  copy($src, $tmp);
  $att = media_handle_sideload(['name' => basename($src), 'tmp_name' => $tmp], $id);
  if (!is_wp_error($att)) set_post_thumbnail($id, $att);
}

$home = wp_insert_post(['post_title' => 'Inicio', 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_name' => 'inicio']);
update_post_meta($home, '_wp_page_template', 'index.php');
$contacto = wp_insert_post(['post_title' => 'Contáctanos', 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_name' => 'contactanos']);
update_post_meta($contacto, '_wp_page_template', 'contacto.php');
update_option('show_on_front', 'page');
update_option('page_on_front', $home);
update_option('blogname', 'DaleColor');
update_option('blogdescription', 'cuadros, prints y láminas decorativas');
update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/');
flush_rewrite_rules();

// Menú principal
$menu = wp_create_nav_menu('Menu principal');
wp_update_nav_menu_item($menu, 0, ['menu-item-title' => 'Inicio', 'menu-item-url' => home_url('/'), 'menu-item-status' => 'publish']);
wp_update_nav_menu_item($menu, 0, ['menu-item-title' => 'Decoración', 'menu-item-url' => get_category_link($deco['term_id']), 'menu-item-status' => 'publish']);
wp_update_nav_menu_item($menu, 0, ['menu-item-title' => 'Estilo', 'menu-item-url' => get_category_link($estilo['term_id']), 'menu-item-status' => 'publish']);
wp_update_nav_menu_item($menu, 0, ['menu-item-title' => 'Contáctanos', 'menu-item-url' => home_url('/contactanos/'), 'menu-item-status' => 'publish']);
$locs = get_theme_mod('nav_menu_locations', []);
$locs['menu-principal'] = $menu;
set_theme_mod('nav_menu_locations', $locs);
